About Me

Hoboken, NJ

Hi, I'm Luke Daniel, graduate student pursuing degrees in Business Analytics & Artificial Intelligence at Stevens Institute of Technology and Sports Technologies & Digital Transformation at Escuela Universitaria Real Madrid, Universidad Europea. I also work as a Software Engineer at VectorScribe, LLC. I earned my bachelor's degree in Data Science and Computer Science from the University of Pittsburgh.

My work sits at the intersection of software, data, and applied AI. At VectorScribe, I build full-stack Python control software for laser holographic microprinting, improving everything from image-processing and hardware-control routines to user interfaces and deployment. Whether I'm analyzing sports data, building AI-powered tools, or designing intuitive interfaces, I enjoy turning complex systems into useful, accessible experiences.
